description: Discover content and take-action campaigns the connected user can join and earn from: every active public campaign plus campaigns from communities the user belongs to. Each item has a kind — 'content' (create a post/thread/video about the product) or 'take_action' (do a concrete action like voting or starring, with URL/description proof). Free, read-only. Follow with get_campaign_brief before doing any work.
name: find_open_campaigns
title: Find campaigns to participate in
